vacancy.title: Electromechanical Engineer for Test Facility
vacancy.assessment: Direct ESTEC test facility role, master's degree and minimum four years relevant experience required specifically in design, operation and maintenance of environmental test facilities for space hardware. Strong transferable machinery/facility engineering background, but space-specific facility experience gap. Employer's LinkedIn posting states initially temporary until 31 July 2027, making it less attractive than comparable ATG position. Separate contractor vacancy, despite similar client service.
